name: create_reminder
description: Create a time-based reminder that will trigger TTS notification. Use this when user asks to be reminded about something at a specific time or after a duration. Supports natural time expressions like 'in 30 minutes', 'in 4 hours', 'tomorrow at 3pm', etc. The reminder will speak via TTS when the time comes.

description.description: Optional additional details about the reminder

when.description: Natural time expression: 'in 30 minutes', 'in 4 hours', 'in 2 days', 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'at 5pm', etc. Use the user's expressed time directly.
